ios.desc:
dishlist helps you find, save, and rank your favorite things on the menu
· Search for specific dishes, drinks, ingredients, cuisines, and more
· Save things you love or want to try
· Rank things by type, like pizza, burger, and breakfast burrito

starting in san francisco
· Explore Dogpatch, Potrero Hill, and Mission Bay
· Browse every menu and every thing on it
· Tell us which place or neighborhood you want next at support@dishlist.com

privacy
· Sign in with Apple without sharing your name, email, or phone number
· Stay private or share your favorites with friends using your user handle
· Approve or deny each follow request

show_hn.title: Show HN: dishlist – an iPhone app for foodie founders near Dogpatch

quotes.text:
I made dishlist, an iPhone app that is available in the App Store. It is a restaurant recommendation app, like Yelp and Beli. It is different because it is built around things on the menu. Playlists let us organize our favorite songs. What if we did that with our favorite things on the menu?

I've indexed every menu item at 109 places in Dogpatch, Potrero Hill, and Mission Bay (4,332 dishes and 5,285 drinks). You can search for the types of things you like and you can even search by ingredient. You can rank your favorite Breakfast Burritos, Boba, or whatever else you like.

Website

https://dishlist.com

Video

https://dishlist.com/demo
